title: Tell us what you want to post.
body: Three fields. One email. You get the image and caption right here — and a copy in your inbox.

topic.label: What's it about?
topic.placeholder: e.g. pricing talks with existing clients
topic.help: One sentence is enough. Max. 280 characters.

expertise.label: Your role or industry
expertise.help: Helps us match the tone. Max. 120 characters.

tone.label: Which tone?
tone.help: Pick a style — it shapes the whole post.

email.label: Where do we send the copy?
email.help: For this post only. No spam.
email.invalidError: That doesn't look like a valid email.

consent.label: I agree my email is used to deliver this post.
consent.requiredError: We need your OK to deliver the post.

form.loadingHelp: Takes around 30 seconds. Keep this window open.

idle.headline: Your post will appear here.
idle.body: Fill in the fields on the left — we build hook, image and caption in under a minute.

loading.headline: We're building your post …
loading.body: Picking hook, structure and image layout. Seconds, not minutes.

success.headline: Done. Here's your post.
success.softCtaBody: Want your own AI content process for your business? Let's talk briefly.

error.headline: Something went wrong.
error.body: We couldn't build the post just now. Try again — your input is saved.
